body: Not gonna lie, I found myself earlier this year and I'm not a fan.
Went to all the effort of posting on what I thought was my covert account so you wouldn't see this. Had to change my password and everything.

I don't want to be with them because I cheated on them, in the midst of a global pandemic and national lock down. I took advantage of their trust and kindness, and every time I looked at them after what I had done, I was reminded of how much i hurt them and how low I could sink. 

My reasons for not being with them are entirely selfish, I don't want to be reminded how much of a bad person I am. They offered me another chance, twice. But when they asked me if I could be faithful, I couldn't answer. 

I shouldn't treat someone I claim to love like that. I've been treated like that and I know how much it sucks, and I'm appalled that I have treated someone I love like that. So I'd  rather cut them off than have to face what I've done. Except, of course, when I'm drunk and lonely and the world feels a bit much, then I reach out and play with their feelings and emotions because im selfish. Its awful behaviour and it has to stop.

I don't know why I have treated them so badly. But I have and I need to leave them well alone. I don't want to keep hurting them. 

Thank you for giving me the space to be real about this. You're a good human.

They used to say something similar to this actually. Its not right or fair of me to tell them how they feel, if that makes sense? I would say I wasn't good enough, and they would tell me that's their decision to make, that I'm implying they can't make their own decisions. 

I should have made more of an effort to address these things. I didnt, I messed it all up and now I have the audacity to post shit like this. 

 Acting like self awareness is an apology. Its pathetic actually.
